scientific_integrity: A direct all-characteristic proof uses the weighted incidence rank of an equal-label support graph and an additive-character count for one cycle. Seventeen finite configurations provide independent numerical checks, not a replacement for the general proof. No independent audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Finite, loopless quiver with at most one arrow between any unordered vertex pair; radical-square-zero quotient; only inner derivation ranks, not full derivation algebra or automorphism orbits. The general subset-sum evaluation may be exponential, and historical publication priority has residual uncertainty.
title: Graphic-matroid adjoint-rank spectra in radical-square-zero quiver algebras
